item.title: Dennis Paagman has timed the rollout
item.description: Ruby 4.0.10 fixed seven security issues, so I checked again how long it took to reach installers, containers and hosting platforms. The official Docker image went from 16 hours to just over one. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: RubyGems and Bundler 4.1 are out
item.description: RubyGems and Bundler 4.1.0 are out. I covered the release in a three-part series on dev.to, and this post picks two changes from each part that you are most likely to use. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: How I Optimized RubyLLM for Coding Agents
item.description: My own framework lost to no framework at first: the coding agent couldn't see how to use it. What I changed, what worked, and how I measured it. (1 source: rubyweekly)
